description: Tests and final integration - pytest test suite covering agent1_bridge, pipeline_planner, EEG stages, ECG stages, and code_generator. Plus final integration ensuring all modules work together.
steps: Create neuropipeline/tests/conftest.py - shared fixtures: sample_agent1_eeg_report (DREAMER-like JSON dict with modality=EEG, known_dataset.name=DREAMER, quality_score.score=85, metadata with 14 channels, 128 Hz, artifacts dict), sample_agent1_ecg_report (MIT-BIH-like JSON with modality=ECG, 2 leads, 360 Hz), sample_pipeline_config (output of plan_pipeline for DREAMER)
Create neuropipeline/tests/test_agent1_bridge.py - test load_agent1_report with valid JSON, test parsing of EEG and ECG reports, test error handling for invalid JSON

Create neuropipeline/tests/test_pipeline_planner.py - test plan_pipeline for DREAMER (expect gat_tcn model, emotion_recognition task, trial-based epochs), test for MIT-BIH ECG (expect resnet1d or cnn1d_lstm), test for Motor Imagery (expect event-based epochs), test for low-channel EEG (expect eegnet)

Create neuropipeline/tests/test_eeg_stages.py - test each EEG stage module's get_config_schema() returns dict with expected keys, test get_default_config() with DREAMER info, test generate_code() produces syntactically valid Python (using ast.parse)
Create neuropipeline/tests/test_ecg_stages.py - test each ECG stage module's get_config_schema()/get_default_config()/generate_code() same pattern as EEG tests

Create neuropipeline/tests/test_code_generator.py - test template-based code generation (mock Jinja2 rendering), test that generate_stage_code returns valid Python for each stage type, test generate_custom_model with mocked Anthropic API response
Ensure all tests pass with pytest neuropipeline/tests/ -v
acceptance_criteria: pytest neuropipeline/tests/ -v runs and all tests pass
test_pipeline_planner.py has at least 4 test cases covering different datasets/modalities
test_code_generator.py mocks the Anthropic API (does not make real API calls in tests)
No test requires external data files or network access
